predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: French Ivory Coast, independent from France on 7 August 1960; Cliopatria carries the land in its French Fifth Republic row for 1958-1960

ledger.x: 7 August 1960: Côte d'Ivoire becomes independent from France.
2011: the north returns to the state.

wars.name: Second Ivorian Civil War
wars.outcome: 'The second civil war ended with Gbagbo's defeat and arrest in April 2011.'

certainty.note: Judgment: the frontier is inherited from the French delimitation ('the northern boundary was not fixed until 1947'); the pages give no later change.
